business.name: Community Help Network
services: Buddy Bags: weekend supplemental food for students on the free-lunch program (two breakfasts, two lunches, two dinners, snacks, and drinks). Students are anonymous to the organization.

Household Pantry: cleaning supplies, paper products, and hygiene items for low-income families in South Lake County, which SNAP cannot buy. Photo ID and proof of residency are required. Open Tuesday and Saturday 9:00 a.m.–12:00 p.m.

Ladle of Love: free community luncheon in the dining hall at 550 East Burrell Drive on the first and third Saturdays, 11:00 a.m.–1:00 p.m. Started March 2022. No charge; free-will offerings accepted but not expected.
Summer Buddy Bags: weekly grocery pickup for eight weeks at 550 East Burrell Drive or Lowell First United Methodist Church, 520 East Commercial Avenue.
Century Club annual giving levels: Red Apple Club $100–$499, Silver Apple Club $500–$999, Gold Apple Club $1,000 and above, with a named apple plaque at the warehouse.
Food-donation drop-off (stated for May, June, and July): Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, Friday, and Saturday, 9:00 a.m.–noon, at the red door by the east-side loading dock, or the after-hours drop box.
business.address: 550 E Burrell Dr, Crown Point, IN 46307 (ARC building warehouse, across from Crown Point High School; loading-dock entrance is the red door on the east side)
